description: Net Swiss salary for a cross-border worker. · Salaire suisse net pour un frontalier. — Converts a gross annual Swiss salary (CHF) to net, deducting the employee shares of AVS/AI/APG, AC (chômage), LPP (2nd pillar) and NBU (non-occupational accident) for the given border canton. Deterministic Swiss payroll rules — no AI. Returns annual + monthly net and the deduction breakdown, with the data year of the rates used.

canton.description: Swiss border canton (GE, VD, JU, NE, BS, VS).
